title: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations: Practice Exams

questions.q: Your code stops the loop whenever Claude's response contains text. When Claude says "Let me check" and also sends a tool call, the tool is never run. What is the correct fix?
options: Continue the loop when stop_reason is "tool_use" and stop when it is "end_turn"
Add "Do not write text" to the prompt
questions.why: The loop is controlled by stop_reason; the presence of text is not a completion signal

questions.q: The synthesis subagent's report is missing the search subagent's findings. The coordinator assumed the subagent could see its conversation. What is the fix?
options: Include the search findings in full in the synthesis subagent's Task prompt
A model with a larger context window
Re-run the search inside the synthesis agent
questions.why: Subagents do not inherit the parent context; we must pass it in the prompt ourselves

questions.q: The coordinator starts 3 independent subagents one by one across 3 turns; latency is high. What is the best fix?
options: Emit 3 Task tool calls in a single coordinator response
questions.why: Multiple Task calls in one response = parallel

questions.q: Even though the rule "refunds over $500 need manager approval" is in the system prompt, the agent sometimes processes $700 refunds. What is the fix?
options: Write "NEVER" in capitals in the prompt
A tool-call interception hook that blocks process_refund calls over $500 and routes them to escalate_to_human
questions.why: Deterministic hooks for financial rules; prompts are probabilistic

questions.q: You have a session from yesterday that analyzed 40 files. Today you refactored only 2 files. What is the best approach?
options: Start a new session and re-explore everything
Use --resume and explicitly mention the 2 changed files
questions.why: Context is mostly still valid → resume + tell it about the changed files

questions.q: The search_docs and search_knowledge tools have nearly identical descriptions; Claude picks the wrong tool. What is the first step?
options: Rewrite the descriptions to include each tool's purpose, inputs, example queries, and "when to use this instead of the other tool" (rename if needed)
Merge the two tools into one
Add 10 few-shot examples to the system prompt
questions.why: Root cause of tool selection = descriptions; low effort, high impact

questions.q: When a database timeout occurs, the lookup_order MCP tool returns an empty list; the agent says "You have no orders". What is the fix?
options: Tell the agent to retry all empty results
Add "If empty, check again" to the prompt
Return the timeout as isError + errorCategory: transient + isRetryable: true; distinguish it from a genuine empty result
Stop the session when a timeout occurs
questions.why: Returning an access failure as an empty success is error suppression

questions.q: The synthesis agent has been given all 15 tools; it runs web searches itself and produces duplicate results. What is the fix?
options: Add "Do not search" to the prompt
Restrict the synthesis agent's tools to those its role needs
questions.why: Least privilege: only the tools the role needs

questions.q: The whole team needs a Jira MCP server; the token must not be committed to Git. Where do you configure it?
questions.why: Project-scope .mcp.json + env var expansion = shared, with no secrets

questions.q: What is the best built-in tool for finding all *.spec.ts files?
questions.why: Glob = file name patterns; Grep = file contents

questions.q: A new developer's Claude Code does not follow the team's commit conventions. The conventions are in the team lead's ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. What is the fix?
options: Move them into the project-level CLAUDE.md
Have the new developer copy the file
questions.why: User-level CLAUDE.md is not shared; project-level is shared through Git

questions.q: A codebase analysis skill fills up the main conversation with long output. What is the fix?
options: context: fork in the SKILL.md frontmatter
questions.why: context: fork runs the skill in an isolated sub-agent context

questions.q: There is an off-by-one bug in a single function; you have a failing test and a stack trace. Which approach?
questions.why: A single-file fix with a clear scope = direct execution

questions.q: On every new commit, the Claude review re-posts the same comments. What is the fix?
options: Give it the previous findings in context and tell it to report only new or still-unresolved issues
questions.why: Give previous findings, report only new / unresolved

questions.q: The security review flags "possible SQL injection" even for parameterized queries. The prompt currently says "only high-confidence issues". What is the best fix?
options: Explicit criteria for injection plus few-shot examples that distinguish a safe parameterized query from a real injection
questions.why: Explicit criteria + few-shot instead of confidence filtering

questions.q: When an invoice has no due date, the model makes up a date. due_date is required in the schema. What is the fix?
questions.why: Required fields cause fabrication; make them nullable

questions.q: Because the PO number is missing, the validation-retry loop retries 3 times. The PO number is in a separate purchase order document that was not sent. What is the best approach?
options: A retry will not solve this — set the field to null and send it to human review, or also send the PO document
questions.why: Information that is not in the source cannot be obtained by retrying

questions.q: A weekly compliance audit of 5,000 documents, with results needed by Monday morning. You need to reduce cost. What do you use?
options: Message Batches API for the audit
Put pre-merge checks in the batch too
questions.why: Latency-tolerant work = batch (50% cheaper, up to 24 hours)

questions.q: After summarization in a long chat, the agent forgets the $89.40 refund amount the customer mentioned. What is the fix?
options: A persistent "case facts" block kept outside the summarized history
questions.why: Keep transactional facts in a separate block instead of summarizing them

questions.q: About a simple address change, the customer says "I want to talk to a human right now". What should the agent do?
options: Resolve it first and offer a human afterwards
questions.why: If the request for a human is explicit, honor it promptly

questions.q: "Add comprehensive tests to the legacy codebase." What is the best decomposition?
options: A fixed pipeline over the files in alphabetical order
Map the structure, identify high-impact areas, and follow a prioritized plan that adapts as dependencies are discovered
Put all the code into one prompt
questions.why: Open-ended work = dynamic, adaptive decomposition

questions.q: You need to compare two refactoring approaches starting from the same codebase analysis.
options: Two new sessions, redoing the analysis
questions.why: Two branches from the same baseline = fork

questions.q: Of the 40 files analyzed yesterday, 30 were refactored today. What is the best approach?
options: A new session with a structured summary of the previous findings
questions.why: Most of the old tool results are stale → new session with a summary

questions.q: Choose 2. What should the coordinator do so that the synthesis subagent cites sources correctly?
options: Pass the findings in a structured format with URL, document, and date metadata
Include the previous agents' full findings in the subagent prompt
Let the synthesis agent re-run the searches itself
questions.why: We must provide the context ourselves; metadata preserves attribution

questions.q: The agent makes many exploratory tool calls to find out which tables are in the database.
options: Expose the database schema as an MCP resource
questions.why: Resources = content catalogs; fewer exploratory calls

questions.q: The Edit tool fails; the anchor text appears 3 times in the file.
options: Read it and write the whole file with Write
questions.why: Read + Write fallback when there is no unique anchor

questions.q: Your MCP code-search tool is better than Grep, but the agent picks Grep.
options: Describe its capabilities and outputs in the MCP tool description
questions.why: The detailed description leads the agent to pick the MCP tool

questions.q: Choose 2. According to the exam guide, which fields should a structured MCP error contain?
questions.why: Category + retryable + human-readable message

questions.q: A 900-line CLAUDE.md covering testing, API, and deployment is hard to maintain.
options: Split it into topic files in .claude/rules/ (testing.md, api-conventions.md, deployment.md)
questions.why: Monolithic CLAUDE.md → topic files in .claude/rules/

questions.q: Terraform conventions should load only when editing Terraform files.
options: A section in the root CLAUDE.md
questions.why: Path glob rule = applies only to matching files

questions.q: You want to customize a team skill just for yourself; it must not affect your teammates.
options: A personal copy under a different name in ~/.claude/skills/
questions.why: Personal variant, under a different name

questions.q: Date conversion is inconsistent even though a long prose description was given.
questions.why: I/O examples are clearer than prose

questions.q: Test generation suggests tests that already exist.
options: Provide the existing test files in context
questions.why: Existing tests in context = no duplicates

questions.q: Sometimes a document's category is unclear, and sometimes new categories appear. Which schema?
options: An enum with "unclear" and "other" + a detail string
questions.why: Extensible + handles unclear cases

questions.q: There are several extraction schemas; the document type is unknown; structured output is mandatory.
questions.why: any = a tool call is mandatory, Claude chooses which one

questions.q: Results must arrive within 30 hours; the Batches API can take up to 24 hours. How often should batches be submitted?
questions.why: 4-hour window + 24 hours of processing ≤ 30 hours (safe route)

questions.q: Developers dismiss most findings; you need to find out which code patterns cause false positives.
questions.why: For analyzing dismissal patterns

questions.q: In an input that combines 20 subagent reports, findings from the middle section are missing from the final report.
options: Put a key findings summary at the start and organize the details with section headers
Randomize the order of the reports
questions.why: Lost-in-the-middle fix

questions.q: get_customer returns 3 customers named "Nimal Perera".
options: Ask for an additional identifier such as email / phone
The account with the most orders
questions.why: Clarification, not heuristic selection

questions.q: Choose 2. Overall accuracy is 97%; what should be done before reducing human review?
options: Analyze accuracy by document type and field
Stop review now because it is 97%
Stratified random sampling of high-confidence extractions
questions.why: The aggregate value hides segments; sampling surfaces new errors
